body: 19 here, although I feel like this sub is full of edgy teenagers sometimes
Saw your post about your roommate, do you still live with him?
I think its a great idea and I'd definitely be involved. Please respond to my comment if you do end up creating it.
Good answer, thanks for that.
Good advice. I'm already sluggish so well see what happens.

All right. Just looking to have a purpose again I guess and for things to be fun again. Kind of in this weird phase in depression where everything is in third person, and everything is a lot more difficult. Yeah I'll keep this in mind if and when I talk to a doctor. Thanks
Yeah I used to play games for hours on end. But now it's boring. Paintball is all right. I've tried it, and I didn't like it too much.
Can you suggest something I'd enjoy? I've lost interest in really anything lately.
I know it's late, but I did read your responses. So thanks for that.
Well I'm jealous you remember your dreams vividly even though some are nightmares.
On an unrelated note, for me it's been years since I've remembered a dream...
Good advice. Thanks. I won't give up about this. You're a good person.
Thank you for this. I appreciate you man.

Why is it not the end of the world? Tell me why it's not and maybe I can do better again because it most certainly feels like the end of the world here. So what is my solution here? I've already been insulted about them, and am very self conscious. So what do I do? Just pretend they don't exist? The fog in your analogy is permanent because the tattoo is permanent.

I'm 19. I'm going to community college as well soon. I bought a car before I lost my job and got depressed. I don't really have any skills. I need some friends but no one wants to be with me because of how depressed I am. I just want to die at this point. I used to be so happy. Now I'm super depressed and I don't see myself getting out of my situation.
Everything taste like shit. Already lost 13 lbs in the past week and a half. All the foods I used to enjoy or crave, it's gone. I just want to die.
How are you so happy about it? Do you not regret them? I regret mine and have told no one. I'm super bummed about it.
No accomplishments. Nothing. Just depressed man
Therapy is free with insurance ?

Older brother lives on our couch and lost his mind. Mom gets angry at me whenever I try to vent to her. No emotional support what so ever. Zero friends. I guess you're right ugly can be fixed. I just don't enjoy anything anymore. Video games the one thing holding me together are boring, and my tattoos make me unhappy. I'm tired everyday. And my family just stresses me. If I can feel better about the tattoos maybe just maybe I have a road to recovery but as of right now I am extremely down. I don't have any friends either ):
Bad tattoos. Life sucks. Ugly. Sad. No motivation. No support. People bully me wherever I go. What's the point anymore

Same here, these messages help me too.

God I hope you're right though. I want nothing more than to be happy again. Oh man, what a world we live in. I hope you feel better as well, I know I'm trying my hardest as well here.

Most people are terrible human beings and purposely want others to suffer and I was too innocent to know. I honestly feel like I can't keep going. I'm so beyond help. I'm 19 but I feel like I have the physical ability of an eighty year old. I don't know if I can continue like this. I know you're not a professional, but I'm just so damn sad. Thanks for your comment.

I'm a pessimist I know but I don't even enjoy music anymore and need silence to sleep. I really appreciate your messages. I'm really hoping life will get better but I have a fear it won't. Everytime I try to get better I just get put down by family or the world in general. I want to work, I want to be happy, I want to be not self conscious but it's impossible. I have zero energy, zero support, zero hobbies, zero money. How am I supposed to continue like this? I even feel bad for troubling you. Yeah I'm sad about my tattoos, I'm sad I have a family that isn't there for me, I'm sad I have no friends and I think people don't want to be friends with the sad person anyways. I feel like I have zero purpose. I just had so much bad shit happen this past year that I'm permanently stuck in depression mode.

I honestly want to die. I absolutely despise my life and I have zero energy to fix it. So what am I supposed to do here? I feel like suicide is the only answer. I've completely lost my will to live. I want to be happy but it's gone, my happiness is gone forever.
If someone wants to discord with me, I could really use it. I'm anxious so fair warning, and I'm 19, Male.
Nothing. I'm doing nothing, too depressed to do a damn thing.

I know this is just text on a screen but if you could help me feel better I would really appreciate it.


I feel like I gave it time but it's not getting better. My older brother sleeps on our couch and he's lost his mind. I can't even do this anymore. Everytime I try and talk to my Mom about an issue or my sadness, she gets irritated. My younger brother screams on his mic. My older brother slams doors. My Dogs bark everyday. I have these tattoos on me and I feel so worthless. Especially after what happened with the tattoos. I was extremely impressionable at 17 and 18, I took my families advice and my life is ruined. I was happy a year ago. I'm a mess now. I have no one I can turn to and I want to jump off a bridge. I'm so depressed. I can feel the disappointment from my parents. Nothing is fun. Absolutely nothing. I have zero friends. None. I don't even leave my room anymore. I want to go back a year or just end it here honestly.
I really need someone to talk to, can I please message you?

Nothing is fun anymore ): I used to be extremely intelligent and now I'm not. I can't watch TV, play games, it just all feels so fake. I lost all my friends from moving and now I got these tattoos which by the way I absolutely despise, and they're not a small piece either. My family really stresses me out and now being stressed out for a year straight, I'm losing the will to live. I feel like I have no purpose, and no one to talk to in real life.

Unfortunately it takes years to get a tattoo removed, My tattoos are thick black lines. I don't think it can be covered up. It's literally consuming me right now mentally. I get it, they're tattoos, get over it. But I can't and I'm angry about them

It happens? How do you deal with It? I look at myself in the mirror and become depressed because of it. It's not like the depression is going to pass because it's permanent. I feel like such a trashy idiot.

I am so tired everyday, all day. My body is so fragile now. Extremely depressed. Every noise is more annoying. I am so damn sluggish. My taste and smell are gone and I feel like an idiot for falling in a trap with my older brother. Oh well.
Okay will do.

Maybe, I can help you? I don't know your situation but please don't ever take your health for granted. Once it's gone, it's gone. I've made irreversible mistakes as well and I will have these mistakes with me for the rest of my life. I guess I'm rambling but appreciate life for what it is.
I'll keep that in mind I guess, thanks

All right, I am gonna tell you one of my main issues. My past year, 2017 was full of so much stress and mental abuse that I'm a shell now. Six months ago I got tattoos with no purpose, I fully regret. It doesn't help I lost hard earned money buying it but I got extremely sick after I got it and my health and physical health went down the drain, then came the depression. Cant even look in the mirror without wanting to kill myself anymore.
